text:
mira: dropping a design question: our compare table legend is getting overloaded. We have latency/throughput/cost/accuracy badges, each with colored microbadges and hover tooltips. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compare-legend-rework
sam: I noticed the legend is stealing visual weight from the rows. Maybe collapse the legend into an accessible popover behind a small ‘i’ icon so the table stays compact.
jos: Agree on collapse. Also: the badge order matters by workload. We should default to latency, accuracy, cost and let users reorder in a tiny settings cog. UX: cog in header -> small popover with drag handles.
tali: Accessibility points: 1) legend info must be reachable via keyboard (not just hover) 2) badges need sr-only labels and a clear tooltip text, e.g., 'Latency: 120 ms (p95)'. 3) small colored chips need contrast tokens; avoid relying on color alone.
aria-bot: A11y checklist reminder: legend popover must be focus-trapped while open, close on ESC, and announce via aria-live if it changes. Tooltips should have role="tooltip" and be tied via aria-describedby. Contrast >=4.5:1 for small badge text.
mira: microcopy dilemma: tooltip headings: 'Latency (p95)' vs 'Latency — p95' vs 'P95 latency'. Which is clearest in a 200ms glance? I lean 'Latency (p95)' since it keeps metric first.
sam: +1 'Latency (p95)'. Also keep tooltip body short: one sentence, e.g. 'Median for recent requests. Updated every 30s.' Avoid long paragraphs.
jos: For the legend popover CTA copy: 'Badge legend' vs 'What these badges mean' vs 'Metrics legend'. I'd vote 'Badge legend' for brevity but 'Metrics legend' might be clearer for new users.
tali: For screen readers, the legend button should have aria-label='Open metrics legend'. The popover should have aria-labelledby pointing to the title inside: 'Metrics legend'. Also ensure keyboard users can tab through badge examples and read the sr-only text.
mira: Implementation notes: 1) collapse legend into popover behind top-right 'legend' icon 2) show a minimal inline indicator in header like '3 badges active' 3) let users reorder badges via header cog 4) include sr-only example strings and contrast swatches in the popover so designers/devs can see tokens.
StagingBot: Preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/compare-legend-2501234567
sam: One more thought: pinned versions that have custom badge priorities should show a tiny star in the badge tray to indicate override. Tooltip: 'Pinned priority' and SR: 'You set a custom badge order for this version.'
jos: Perf: don't mount complex tooltips for every row. Render them lazily on hover/focus. Use transform + opacity for reveal to avoid layout shifts. Virtualize rows for large catalogs so keyboard nav is smooth.
tali: Also include a reduced-motion alternative in the spec: instant show/hide and no pulse. And add tests to the e2e suite for keyboard-only navigation to open legend and read badges.
mira: Great. I'll update figma with 'Metrics legend' popover, add aria strings, include contrast tokens in the popover, and add the star indicator for per-version overrides. Will attach the aria text and CSS tokens in the PR so QA can run checks. Thanks! :sparkles:
